articles.summary: AfterQuery celebrates the release of Motif 3, a landmark model for Korean sovereign AI, and is proud to have served as its sole data partner: an MIT-licensed 314B-parameter sparse MoE that leads its open-model comparison set on agentic benchmarks.
articles.title: AfterQuery Celebrates the Release of Motif 3 and Served as Sole Data Partner

articles.summary: How AfterQuery and Legora built the Benchmark for Agentic Reasoning (BAR): 5,161 cases across 28 practice areas and 11,075 source documents, testing whether agents can complete end-to-end legal work inside Legora’s custom harness.
articles.title: Building a Frontier Legal Evaluation in Partnership with Legora
